d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how the United States and Egypt have deepened their economic ties by signing the landmark Strategic Objective Agreement for Advancing Mutual Prosperity. Signed on November 4 by US Embassy Chargé d’Affaires Robert Silverman and Egyptian Deputy Foreign Minister Samar Al-Ahdal, the bilateral framework establishes a multi-year effort to modernise critical sectors including artificial intelligence, energy, infrastructure, healthcare, water management, and agriculture.
